## Core CSS Architecture

Every project uses the same CSS layer system, always imported in this order:

1. `base.css` — CSS reset + box-sizing + `#app` full size
2. `posoroko.css` — **The core utility library** (like a minimal Tailwind). Classes: `.flex`, `.column`, `.gap20`, `.weight7`, `.fS18`, `.absolute`, `.pointer`, etc. Never modify this for project-specific styles.
3. `typography.css` — Font imports (Google Fonts), font CSS variables, font-weight classes
4. `architecture.css` — Structural skeleton only: containers, top bar, footer, mobile frame, grid areas. No colors or fonts. Two reference versions will live here once defined: `architecture_mobile_only.css` and `architecture_classic_webpage.css`
5. `main.css` — Project-specific global styles
6. Entry point: `_styles_.css` imports all of the above (Vue). In Nuxt, the `css[]` array in `nuxt.config.ts` replaces it.

In Nuxt projects, the CSS array in `nuxt.config.ts` replaces `_styles_.css`.

---

## Code Style

See `_STUDIO/code-style.md`. Summary:
- Tabs, no semicolons
- Single quotes for code, double quotes for content/French text
- camelCase for JS names and CSS classes, kebab-case for CSS variables only
- PascalCase component files, kebab-case page files
- `function` declarations at top level, arrow functions inline
- Beginner-level, comprehensive names always
- `<script setup lang="ts">` always
